segments.source: Operations
segments.translation: 운영

segments.source: "Operations" is a part of the Compiler Team that takes care of organizational and maintenance work and in general help things moving forward.
segments.translation: "운영"은 컴파일러 팀의 일부로, 조직 및 유지 관리 업무를 맡으며 전반적으로 일이 원활하게 진행되도록 돕습니다.

segments.source: T-compiler ops lives on Zulip under [#t-compiler/ops][t-compiler-ops].
segments.translation: T-compiler 운영 팀은 Zulip의 [#t-compiler/ops][t-compiler-ops]에서 활동합니다.

segments.source: Here is a list of recurring tasks.
segments.translation: 다음은 정기적으로 수행하는 작업 목록입니다.

segments.source: Ideally run through this list every week.
segments.translation: 가능하면 매주 이 목록을 점검하십시오.

segments.source: If there are blockers or doubts, after having acquired the right context, don't hesitate to ping people around.
segments.translation: 진행을 가로막는 문제나 의문점이 있다면 적절한 맥락을 파악한 뒤 주저하지 말고 관련된 사람들에게 핑을 보내십시오.

segments.source: Contributors are the best resource of the project (and we want to be mindful of their time) and are always helpful.
segments.translation: 기여자는 프로젝트의 가장 소중한 자원이며(그러므로 우리는 그들의 시간을 배려하고자 합니다) 언제나 기꺼이 도와줍니다.

segments.source: You can trigger a discussion about a specific topic, issue or pull request by opening a new topic on Zulip in [#t-compiler][t-compiler] or, if it needs consensus and more focus from the team, it can be labeled `I-compiler-nominated` and will be discussed in a meeting (see section [Meetings][meetings]).
segments.translation: 특정 주제, 이슈 또는 풀 리퀘스트에 대한 논의는 Zulip의 [#t-compiler][t-compiler]에 새 토픽을 열어 시작할 수 있으며, 합의가 필요하고 팀이 더 집중해서 다뤄야 하는 경우에는 `I-compiler-nominated` 레이블을 붙여 회의에서 논의할 수 있습니다([회의][meetings] 절 참조).

segments.source: Issues hygiene
segments.translation: 이슈 관리

segments.source: [Issue to be prioritized](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AI-prioritize): see [prioritization](https://forge.rust-lang.org/compiler/prioritization.html).
segments.translation: [우선순위를 지정해야 할 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AI-prioritize): [우선순위 지정](https://forge.rust-lang.org/compiler/prioritization.html)을 참조하십시오.

segments.source: [P-high issues without assignee](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AT-compiler+label%3AP-high+no%3Aassignee): ideally this category of issues should have an assignee (filter out those without a PR).
segments.translation: [담당자가 없는 P-high 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AT-compiler+label%3AP-high+no%3Aassignee): 이 범주의 이슈에는 가능하면 담당자가 있어야 합니다(PR이 없는 이슈만 걸러 내십시오).

segments.source: In rare cases it's fine if they don't.
segments.translation: 드물게는 담당자가 없어도 괜찮습니다.

segments.source: [MCP in FCP status](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Afinal-comment-period+sort%3Acreated-asc), close seconded since more 10 days, ensure no open concerns
segments.translation: [FCP 상태인 MCP](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Afinal-comment-period+sort%3Acreated-asc): 재청된 지 10일이 넘은 MCP를 종료하되, 해결되지 않은 우려 사항이 없는지 확인하십시오

segments.source: [Check open MCPs](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Amajor-change+-label%3Afinal-comment-period+sort%3Aupdated-asc): [MCP is a protocol](https://forge.rust-lang.org/compiler/proposals-and-stabilization.html) to bring proposals to the compiler team attention.
segments.translation: [열린 MCP 확인](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Amajor-change+-label%3Afinal-comment-period+sort%3Aupdated-asc): [MCP는 제안을 컴파일러 팀에 알리기 위한 절차](https://forge.rust-lang.org/compiler/proposals-and-stabilization.html)입니다.

segments.source: Ensure MCPs are moving towards one of these two outcome, being seconded or being closed for lack of seconding.
segments.translation: MCP가 재청되거나 재청되지 않아 종료되는 두 결과 중 하나를 향해 진행되고 있는지 확인하십시오.

segments.source: When it's clear that an MCP won't be seconded or is abandoned, after about two or three months is ok to query its status and evaluate closing it.
segments.translation: MCP가 재청되지 않을 것이 분명하거나 방치된 경우, 약 두세 달이 지난 뒤에는 상태를 문의하고 종료 여부를 검토해도 됩니다.

segments.source: Otherwise try to get them unstuck.
segments.translation: 그렇지 않은 경우에는 막힌 MCP가 다시 진행되도록 도우십시오.

segments.source: [Issues needing a MCVE](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AE-needs-mcve+label%3AT-compiler+sort%3Acreated-asc)
segments.translation: [MCVE가 필요한 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AE-needs-mcve+label%3AT-compiler+sort%3Acreated-asc)

segments.source: [Issues and PRs that are going through FCP](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+label%3Afinished-final-comment-period): check if the team need to check their box.
segments.translation: [FCP가 진행 중인 이슈와 PR](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+label%3Afinished-final-comment-period): 팀이 체크박스를 표시해야 하는지 확인하십시오.

segments.source: These issues are in the weekly triage meeting agenda.
segments.translation: 이 이슈들은 주간 트리아지 회의 안건에 포함됩니다.

segments.source: Prioritization for T-compiler
segments.translation: T-compiler의 우선순위 지정

segments.source: See here how to [prioritization][prioritization] works.
segments.translation: [우선순위 지정][prioritization]이 어떻게 이루어지는지는 여기를 참조하십시오.

segments.source: Some useful filters when looking at regressions.
segments.translation: 회귀를 살펴볼 때 유용한 필터는 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: [Nightly regressions without priority](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-nightly+-label%3AI-prioritize++is%3Aopen)
segments.translation: [우선순위가 없는 nightly 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-nightly+-label%3AI-prioritize++is%3Aopen)

segments.source: [Beta regressions without priority](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-beta+-label%3AI-prioritize)
segments.translation: [우선순위가 없는 beta 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-beta+-label%3AI-prioritize)

segments.source: [Stable regressions without priority](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-stable+-label%3AI-prioritize)
segments.translation: [우선순위가 없는 stable 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-stable+-label%3AI-prioritize)

segments.source: [Untriaged regressions without a priority](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-untriaged+-label%3AP-critical+-label%3AP-high+-label%3AP-medium+-label%3AP-low+-label%3AI-prioritize)
segments.translation: [우선순위가 없고 트리아지되지 않은 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AT-compiler+label%3Aregression-untriaged+-label%3AP-critical+-label%3AP-high+-label%3AP-medium+-label%3AP-low+-label%3AI-prioritize)

segments.source: PRs hygiene
segments.translation: PR 관리

segments.source: Every PR should have a team assigned
segments.translation: 모든 PR에는 팀이 지정되어 있어야 합니다

segments.source: [PR without a team label](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+draft%3Afalse+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AT-rustdoc-frontend+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-types+-label%3AT-style+-label%3AT-bootstrap+-label%3AT-opsem+sort%3Acreated-asc)
segments.translation: [팀 레이블이 없는 PR](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+draft%3Afalse+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AT-rustdoc-frontend+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-types+-label%3AT-style+-label%3AT-bootstrap+-label%3AT-opsem+sort%3Acreated-asc)

segments.source: [Waiting on author](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+draft%3Afalse+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AT-rustdoc-frontend+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-types+-label%3AT-style+-label%3AT-bootstrap+label%3AS-waiting-on-author+sort%3Aupdated-asc)
segments.translation: [작성자 응답 대기 중](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+draft%3Afalse+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AT-rustdoc-frontend+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-types+-label%3AT-style+-label%3AT-bootstrap+label%3AS-waiting-on-author+sort%3Aupdated-asc)

segments.source: [Waiting on a review](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+draft%3Afalse+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AT-rustdoc-frontend+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-types+-label%3AT-style+-label%3AT-bootstrap+label%3AS-waiting-on-review+sort%3Aupdated-asc)
segments.translation: [리뷰 대기 중](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+draft%3Afalse+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AT-rustdoc-frontend+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-types+-label%3AT-style+-label%3AT-bootstrap+label%3AS-waiting-on-review+sort%3Aupdated-asc)

segments.source: Things to do a week before the release:
segments.translation: 릴리스 일주일 전에 할 일:

segments.source: [No regression without priority](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3AT-compiler%20is%3Aopen%20%20label%3AI-prioritize): ensure they've been fixed and if not try to get the team attention.
segments.translation: [우선순위가 없는 회귀가 없어야 합니다](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3AT-compiler%20is%3Aopen%20%20label%3AI-prioritize): 회귀가 수정되었는지 확인하고, 수정되지 않았다면 팀의 관심을 끌도록 노력하십시오.

segments.source: No [beta regressions](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-beta%20label%3AT-compiler%20is%3Aopen%20no%3Aassignee) or [stable regressions](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-stable%20label%3AT-compiler%20is%3Aopen%20no%3Aassignee) regressions without an owner, filter out those out without a PR.
segments.translation: 담당자가 없는 [beta 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-beta%20label%3AT-compiler%20is%3Aopen%20no%3Aassignee)나 [stable 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-stable%20label%3AT-compiler%20is%3Aopen%20no%3Aassignee)가 없어야 합니다. PR이 없는 회귀는 걸러 내십시오.

segments.source: No [beta regressions](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-beta+label%3AT-compiler+is%3Aopen) or [stable regressions](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-stable+label%3AT-compiler+is%3Aopen) regressions work in progress, ideally they should all be merged.
segments.translation: 작업이 진행 중인 [beta 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-beta+label%3AT-compiler+is%3Aopen)나 [stable 회귀](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=label%3Aregression-from-stable-to-stable+label%3AT-compiler+is%3Aopen)가 없어야 합니다. 이상적으로는 모두 병합되어 있어야 합니다.

segments.source: Ensure breaking changes (i.e. regressions agreed to be acceptable) have a corresponding issue tagged `relnotes-tracking-issue`, see [list of release notes](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Aopen+label%3Arelnotes-tracking-issue).
segments.translation: 호환성을 깨는 변경(즉, 수용할 수 있다고 합의된 회귀)마다 `relnotes-tracking-issue` 태그가 붙은 이슈가 있는지 확인하십시오. [릴리스 노트 목록](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Aopen+label%3Arelnotes-tracking-issue)을 참고하십시오.

segments.source: T-release will then pick them up and add them to the release notes.
segments.translation: 그러면 T-release가 이를 가져와 릴리스 노트에 추가합니다.

segments.source: After the release
segments.translation: 릴리스 이후

segments.source: Check carefully which regressions can be closed as "accepted".
segments.translation: 어떤 회귀를 "수용됨"으로 닫을 수 있는지 신중하게 확인하십시오.

segments.source: Add a comment clarifying that the PR causing the regression is accepted as breaking change, example: "Closing since PR #123456 will be mentioned in the release notes".
segments.translation: 회귀를 일으킨 PR이 호환성을 깨는 변경으로 수용되었음을 밝히는 댓글을 추가하십시오. 예: "PR #123456이 릴리스 노트에 언급될 예정이므로 닫습니다".

segments.source: Discussions and comments about this practice can be directed on [Zulip](https://rust-lang.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/242269-t-release.2Ftriage/topic/beta.20regressions.20that.20are.20no.20more/near/456509338).
segments.translation: 이 관행에 대한 논의와 의견은 [Zulip](https://rust-lang.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/242269-t-release.2Ftriage/topic/beta.20regressions.20that.20are.20no.20more/near/456509338)에서 나눌 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Meetings
segments.translation: 회의

segments.source: T-compiler has two kinds of meetings: triage and design meetings.
segments.translation: T-compiler에는 트리아지 회의와 설계 회의, 두 종류의 회의가 있습니다.

segments.source: Triage meetings happen weekly on Thursdays (you can subscribe to the Team Compiler calendar [from this repository][compiler-calendar] ), there is a [tool](https://github.com/rust-lang/triagebot/blob/master/src/bin/prioritization-agenda.rs) to generate most of the meeting's agenda (see [Triage meetings](#triage-meetings) for details).
segments.translation: 트리아지 회의는 매주 목요일에 열립니다([이 저장소에서][compiler-calendar] Team Compiler 캘린더를 구독할 수 있습니다). 회의 안건 대부분을 생성하는 [도구](https://github.com/rust-lang/triagebot/blob/master/src/bin/prioritization-agenda.rs)도 있습니다(자세한 내용은 [트리아지 회의](#triage-meetings)를 참고하십시오).

segments.source: Design meetings proposals are advanced on the [T-compiler repository](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc%20is%3Aissue%20is%3Aopen%20label%3Ameeting-proposal) and scheduled during recurrent *steering* meetings (where the next *design* meetings are scheduled).
segments.translation: 설계 회의 제안은 [T-compiler 저장소](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc%20is%3Aissue%20is%3Aopen%20label%3Ameeting-proposal)에서 진행됩니다. 일정은 정기적으로 열리는 *운영(steering)* 회의에서 잡힙니다. 다음 *설계* 회의 일정도 이 회의에서 정합니다.

segments.source: Design meetings also need an agenda and a bit of work to summarize the topic and bring together documentation, invite relevant people and so on.
segments.translation: 설계 회의에도 안건이 필요합니다. 또한 주제를 요약하고, 문서를 취합하고, 관련자를 초대하는 등의 작업도 어느 정도 필요합니다.

segments.source: Weekly triage meeting
segments.translation: 주간 트리아지 회의

segments.source: First, ensure that relevant issues are labelled as `T-compiler`:
segments.translation: 먼저 관련 이슈에 `T-compiler` 레이블이 붙어 있는지 확인하십시오:

segments.source: [Issues labeled with `I-prioritize`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+-label%3AP-critical+-label%3AP-high+-label%3AP-medium+-label%3AP-low+label%3AI-prioritize+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)
segments.translation: [`I-prioritize` 레이블이 붙은 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+-label%3AP-critical+-label%3AP-high+-label%3AP-medium+-label%3AP-low+label%3AI-prioritize+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)

segments.source: [Pull requests nominated for the stable release channel backport](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aall+label%3Astable-nominated+-label%3Astable-accepted+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)
segments.translation: [stable 릴리스 채널 백포트에 상정된 풀 리퀘스트](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aall+label%3Astable-nominated+-label%3Astable-accepted+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)

segments.source: [Pull requests nominated for the beta release channel backport](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aall+label%3Abeta-nominated+-label%3Abeta-accepted+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)
segments.translation: [beta 릴리스 채널 백포트에 상정된 풀 리퀘스트](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aall+label%3Abeta-nominated+-label%3Abeta-accepted+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)

segments.source: [Issues labeled `I-compiler-nominated`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AI-nominated+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui) (i.e. needing a T-compiler discussion)
segments.translation: [`I-compiler-nominated` 레이블이 붙은 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AI-nominated+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)(즉, T-compiler의 논의가 필요한 이슈)

segments.source: [Pull requests waiting on a team's feedback](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AS-waiting-on-team+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)
segments.translation: [팀의 피드백을 기다리는 풀 리퀘스트](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AS-waiting-on-team+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)

segments.source: [Issues classified with priority `P-high`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AP-high+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)
segments.translation: [우선순위가 `P-high`로 분류된 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AP-high+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)

segments.source: [Issues classified with priority `P-critical`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AP-critical+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)
segments.translation: [우선순위가 `P-critical`로 분류된 이슈](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3AP-critical+-label%3AT-compiler+-label%3AT-cargo+-label%3AT-core+-label%3AT-doc+-label%3AT-infra+-label%3AT-lang+-label%3AT-libs+-label%3AT-release+-label%3AT-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc+-label%3AA-rustdoc-ui)

segments.source: ..and that prioritization has been completed.
segments.translation: ..그리고 우선순위 지정이 완료되었는지 확인하십시오.

segments.source: Regressions labeled with `I-prioritize` are signaling that a priority assessment is waiting.
segments.translation: `I-prioritize` 레이블이 붙은 회귀는 우선순위 평가를 기다리고 있다는 뜻입니다.

segments.source: When this label is added to an issue, the `triagebot` sends a notification to the [`#t-compiler/prioritization/alerts`][prio_channel] Zulip channel.
segments.translation: 이 레이블이 이슈에 추가되면 `triagebot`이 [`#t-compiler/prioritization/alerts`][prio_channel] Zulip 채널로 알림을 보냅니다.

segments.source: Ideally, all [`T-compiler` issues with a `I-prioritize` label][issues_needing_prio] should have a priority assigned, or strive to reach this goal: sometimes different factors are blocking issues from being assigned a priority label, either because the report or the context is unclear or because cannot be reproduced and an MCVE would help.
segments.translation: 이상적으로는 [`I-prioritize` 레이블이 붙은 모든 `T-compiler` 이슈][issues_needing_prio]에 우선순위가 지정되어 있어야 합니다. 그렇지 않다면 이 목표에 도달하도록 노력하십시오. 때로는 여러 요인 때문에 이슈에 우선순위 레이블을 지정하지 못하기도 합니다. 보고 내용이나 맥락이 불분명한 경우도 있고, 재현할 수 없어 MCVE가 있으면 도움이 되는 경우도 있습니다.

segments.source: Don't hesitate to ask for clarifications to the issue reporter or to other contributors.
segments.translation: 이슈 보고자나 다른 기여자에게 주저하지 말고 설명을 요청하십시오.

segments.source: Review [stable][stable_regressions], [beta][beta_regressions] and [nightly][nightly_regressions] and try to ensure they are assigned when possible.
segments.translation: [stable][stable_regressions], [beta][beta_regressions], [nightly][nightly_regressions]를 검토하고, 가능하면 담당자가 배정되도록 하십시오.

segments.source: The final step prior to generating the agenda is to accept Major Change Proposals (MCP), this is usually automated.
segments.translation: 안건을 생성하기 전 마지막 단계는 주요 변경 제안(MCP)을 수락하는 것이며, 이 작업은 보통 자동화되어 있습니다.

segments.source: MCPs that have been in the Final Comment Period (FCP) phase (identified by having the [`final-comment-period` label][mcp_fcp]) for more than ten days can be accepted.
segments.translation: 최종 의견 수렴 기간(FCP) 단계([`final-comment-period` 레이블][mcp_fcp]이 붙어 있는 것으로 식별됨)에 10일 넘게 머물러 있는 MCP는 수락할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If an MCP has no unresolved concerns (look for the `has-concerns` label), you can remove the `final-comment-period` label, add the `major-change-accepted` label and close the issue.
segments.translation: MCP에 해결되지 않은 우려 사항이 없다면(`has-concerns` 레이블을 확인하십시오) `final-comment-period` 레이블을 제거하고 `major-change-accepted` 레이블을 추가한 뒤 이슈를 닫으면 됩니다.

segments.source: Finally, the meeting agenda can be generated.
segments.translation: 마지막으로 회의 안건을 생성할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Clone and build [`triagebot`][triagebot] and run:
segments.translation: [`triagebot`][triagebot]을 클론하여 빌드한 뒤 다음을 실행하십시오:

segments.source: Copy the content into a new HackMD in the "Rust Lang Compiler Team" space.
segments.translation: 내용을 "Rust Lang Compiler Team"(Rust 언어 컴파일러 팀) 공간의 새 HackMD 문서에 복사하십시오.

segments.source: The tool will also download the latest weekly compiler triage logs.
segments.translation: 이 도구는 최신 주간 컴파일러 트리아지 로그도 내려받습니다.

segments.source: In case it didn't work out, manually copy the most recent [performance triage logs][perf_triage_log] (doing a bit of cleanup, removing anything that won't display well in Zulip)
segments.translation: 이 작업이 제대로 되지 않았다면 가장 최근의 [성능 트리아지 로그][perf_triage_log]를 직접 복사하십시오(약간 정리하여 Zulip에서 잘 표시되지 않을 내용은 제거하십시오).

segments.source: Add additional manual details to the agenda:
segments.translation: 안건에 다음 세부 사항을 직접 추가하십시오:

segments.source: Add summaries of stable/beta nominations (e.g. who nominated the backport and why)
segments.translation: stable/beta 상정 건의 요약을 추가하십시오(예: 누가 백포트를 상정했고 그 이유는 무엇인지).

segments.source: Add summaries of PRs waiting on the team (i.e. why are they waiting)
segments.translation: 팀의 응답을 기다리는 PR의 요약을 추가하십시오(즉, 왜 대기 중인지).

segments.source: Add initial impressions of `P-critical`/`P-high` bugs
segments.translation: `P-critical`/`P-high` 버그에 대한 초기 소견을 추가하십시오.

segments.source: Add summaries of nominated issues (e.g. who the assignee is, why it was nominated, etc)
segments.translation: 상정된 이슈의 요약을 추가하십시오(예: 담당자가 누구인지, 왜 상정되었는지 등).

segments.source: Populate the oldest PRs waiting on review
segments.translation: 리뷰를 기다리는 가장 오래된 PR 목록을 채우십시오.

segments.source: Use judgement to determine whether a ping is appropriate (e.g. if the pull request is an experiment, it may not need a review; how long has it been since review activity; what do recent comments say?)
segments.translation: 핑을 보내는 것이 적절한지 판단하십시오(예: 풀 리퀘스트가 실험용이라면 리뷰가 필요하지 않을 수도 있습니다. 마지막 리뷰 활동 이후 얼마나 지났는지, 최근 댓글 내용은 어떠한지도 살펴보십시오).

segments.source: About two hours prior to the meeting, announce and share the completed agenda in the Zulip thread for the upcoming meeting (creating it if it does not already exist):
segments.translation: 회의 약 두 시간 전에 다가오는 회의의 Zulip 스레드에 완성된 안건을 공지하고 공유하십시오(스레드가 아직 없다면 새로 만드십시오):

segments.source: It is always recommended to re-run the generator and copy any new details over to the agenda as issue statuses on GitHub may have changed.
segments.translation: GitHub에서 이슈 상태가 바뀌었을 수 있으므로, 생성기를 다시 실행하여 새로운 세부 사항을 안건에 옮겨 적는 것을 항상 권장합니다.

segments.source: After the meeting, there are a few closing tasks:
segments.translation: 회의가 끝난 후에는 몇 가지 마무리 작업이 있습니다:

segments.source: Lock the agenda on HackMD assigning write permissions to `Owners`.
segments.translation: HackMD에서 쓰기 권한을 `Owners`에게 부여하여 안건을 잠그십시오.

segments.source: Remove the `to-announce` label from [MCPs], unless this label was added exactly during the meeting (and therefore will be seen during the following meeting).
segments.translation: [MCP][MCPs]에서 `to-announce` 레이블을 제거하십시오. 단, 이 레이블이 바로 회의 도중에 추가된 경우(따라서 다음 회의에서 다뤄질 경우)는 예외입니다.

segments.source: Remove `to-announce` FCPs from [`rust-lang/rust`][rust_announce], [`compiler-team`][team_announce] and the [forge][forge_announce].
segments.translation: [`rust-lang/rust`][rust_announce], [`compiler-team`][team_announce], [forge][forge_announce]에서 `to-announce` FCP를 제거하십시오.

segments.source: Same disclaimer as before regarding changes during the meeting.
segments.translation: 회의 도중의 변경 사항에 관해서는 앞과 동일한 단서가 적용됩니다.

segments.source: Accept or decline [`beta nominated`][beta_nominated] and [`stable nominated`][stable_nominated] backports that have been accepted during the meeting.
segments.translation: 회의에서 수락된 [`beta nominated`][beta_nominated] 및 [`stable nominated`][stable_nominated] 백포트를 수락하거나 거절하십시오.

segments.source: For more info check [`t-release` backporting docs][release_backports]
segments.translation: 자세한 내용은 [`t-release` 백포트 문서][release_backports]를 확인하십시오.

segments.source: To accept a backport, add a `{beta,stable}-accepted` label and keep the `{beta,stable}-nominated` label.
segments.translation: 백포트를 수락하려면 `{beta,stable}-accepted` 레이블을 추가하고 `{beta,stable}-nominated` 레이블은 그대로 두십시오.

segments.source: Other automated procedures will process these pull requests, it's important to leave both labels.
segments.translation: 다른 자동화 절차가 이 풀 리퀘스트들을 처리하므로 두 레이블을 모두 남겨 두는 것이 중요합니다.

segments.source: Add a comment on Github linking the Zulip discussion.
segments.translation: GitHub에 Zulip 논의 링크를 담은 댓글을 추가하십시오.

segments.source: To decline a backport, simply remove `{beta,stable}-nominated` label.
segments.translation: 백포트를 거절하려면 `{beta,stable}-nominated` 레이블을 제거하기만 하면 됩니다.

segments.source: Add a comment on Github explaining why the backport was declined and link the Zulip discussion.
segments.translation: GitHub에 백포트가 거절된 이유를 설명하는 댓글을 추가하고 Zulip 논의 링크를 첨부하십시오.

segments.source: Remove [`I-compiler-nominated`][compiler_nominated] label from issues that were discussed.
segments.translation: 논의된 이슈에서 [`I-compiler-nominated`][compiler_nominated] 레이블을 제거하십시오.

segments.source: Sometimes not all nominated issues are discussed (because of time constraints) and can slip to the next meeting.
segments.translation: (시간 제약 때문에) 상정된 이슈가 모두 논의되지 못하고 다음 회의로 넘어가는 경우도 있습니다.

segments.source: P-high issues triage meeting
segments.translation: P-high 이슈 트리아지 회의

segments.source: About every 6 months we review the queue of open issues labeled with `P-high` (here the list of [past meetings](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues/900)): goal of this meeting is to re-evaluate the priority of these `P-high` issues, which for a reason or another could be downgraded (too many `P-high` issues lingering for too long becomes background noise and shadows the real high-priority ones).
segments.translation: 약 6개월마다 `P-high` 레이블이 붙은 열린 이슈의 큐를 검토합니다([지난 회의](https://github.com/rust-lang/compiler-team/issues/900) 목록은 여기에 있습니다). 이 회의의 목적은 이러한 `P-high` 이슈의 우선순위를 재평가하는 것입니다. 이 이슈들은 여러 이유로 우선순위가 낮아질 수 있습니다(너무 많은 `P-high` 이슈가 너무 오래 남아 있으면 배경 소음이 되어 실제로 우선순위가 높은 이슈를 가리게 됩니다).

segments.source: We use [this tool](https://github.com/apiraino/compiler-p-high-issues-triage) to generate the agenda.
segments.translation: 안건을 생성하는 데에는 [이 도구](https://github.com/apiraino/compiler-p-high-issues-triage)를 사용합니다.

segments.source: Triage meetings notes are then uploaded on [HackMD](https://hackmd.io/team/rust-compiler-team?nav=overview&tags=%5B%22p-high-issues%22%5D).
segments.translation: 트리아지 회의록은 이후 [HackMD](https://hackmd.io/team/rust-compiler-team?nav=overview&tags=%5B%22p-high-issues%22%5D)에 업로드됩니다.

segments.source: Rest of the world
segments.translation: 다른 팀 현황

segments.source: These filters are for checking what's happening in other teams
segments.translation: 이 필터들은 다른 팀에서 어떤 일이 진행되고 있는지 확인하기 위한 것입니다

segments.source: [List of open RFCs](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aproposed-final-comment-period+label%3Adisposition-merge+sort%3Aupdated-asc) (all teams) waiting for the team to discuss or check the proposal, can anything be done to help moving them forward?
segments.translation: 팀이 제안을 논의하거나 검토하기를 기다리고 있는 [열린 RFC 목록](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aproposed-final-comment-period+label%3Adisposition-merge+sort%3Aupdated-asc)(모든 팀)입니다. 이 RFC들이 진행되도록 도울 수 있는 일이 있습니까?

segments.source: Useful tips
segments.translation: 유용한 팁

segments.source: Github Issues Dashboard
segments.translation: GitHub Issues 대시보드

segments.source: You can utilize the [GitHub Issues Dashboard](https://github.com/issues/) to create custom filters.
segments.translation: [GitHub Issues 대시보드](https://github.com/issues/)를 활용하여 사용자 지정 필터를 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The filters allow you to aggregate both issues and PRs from *multiple* repositories, and allows applying [advanced filters][adv-filters].
segments.translation: 이 필터를 사용하면 *여러* 저장소의 이슈와 PR을 한데 모아 볼 수 있으며, [고급 필터][adv-filters]도 적용할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: See <https://github.blog/changelog/2025-04-02-github-issues-dashboard-updates/>.
segments.translation: <https://github.blog/changelog/2025-04-02-github-issues-dashboard-updates/>를 참고하십시오.
